metas.name: How to Rob a Bank
metas.description: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. metas.name: Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol
metas.description: A thrilling ghost story set in Dickens' London, following one man's supernatural journey to face his past, present and future as he fights for a second chance at redemption.

metas.name: Victorian Psycho
metas.description: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

metas.name: Wildwood
metas.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.

metas.name: Wild Horse Nine
metas.description: CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing mission from Santiago to Easter Island during 1973 in Chile.

metas.name: Being Heumann
metas.description: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

metas.name: I Play Rocky
metas.description: A failing actor writes the ultimate underdog story and must fight for his chance to play the role of a lifetime - Rocky Balboa.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus Zero
metas.description: Direct continuation of Takashi Yamazaki's Godzilla Minus One.

metas.name: Avedon
metas.description: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. metas.name: Fjord
metas.description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

metas.name: Prima Facie
metas.description: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty. metas.name: Where Is the Friend's House?
metas.description: Eight-year-old Ahmed has mistakenly taken his friend Mohammad's notebook. He wants to return it, or else his friend will be expelled from school. The boy determinedly sets out to find Mohammad's home in the neighbouring village.

metas.name: Artificial
metas.description: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. metas.name: Queen of Earth
metas.description: Two women who grew up together discover they have drifted apart when they retreat to a lake house together.

metas.name: The Bitter Tears of Petra von Kant
metas.description: A troubled fashion designer strikes up a romance with a much younger woman.

metas.name: Happy Together
metas.description: A couple take a trip to Argentina but both men find their lives drifting apart in opposite directions.

metas.name: Memoria
metas.description: A woman from Scotland, while traveling in Colombia, begins to notice strange sounds. Soon she begins to think about their appearance.

metas.name: Safe
metas.description: An affluent and unexceptional homemaker in the suburbs develops multiple chemical sensitivity.

metas.name: Pink Flamingos
metas.description: Notorious Baltimore criminal and underground figure Divine goes up against a sleazy married couple who make a passionate attempt to humiliate her and seize her tabloid-given title as "The Filthiest Person Alive".

metas.name: Drive My Car
metas.description: A renowned stage actor and director learns to cope with a big personal loss when he receives an offer to direct a production of Uncle Vanya in Hiroshima.

metas.name: Titane
metas.description: Following a series of unexplained crimes, a father is reunited with the son who has been missing for ten years.

metas.name: Possession
metas.description: A woman starts exhibiting increasingly disturbing behavior after asking her husband for a divorce. Suspicions of infidelity soon give way to something much more sinister.

metas.name: Saint Maud
metas.description: A pious nurse becomes dangerously obsessed with saving the soul of her dying patient.

metas.name: Dogtooth
metas.description: A controlling, manipulative father locks his three adult offspring in a state of perpetual childhood by keeping them prisoner within the sprawling family compound.

metas.name: Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
metas.description: A lonely widowed housewife does her daily chores, takes care of her apartment where she lives with her teenage son, and turns the occasional trick to make ends meet, but something happens that changes her safe routine.

metas.name: Onibaba
metas.description: Two women kill samurai and sell their belongings for a living. While one of them is having an affair with their neighbor, the other woman meets a mysterious samurai wearing a bizarre mask.

metas.name: The Piano Teacher
metas.description: A young man romantically pursues his masochistic piano teacher.

metas.name: Climax
metas.description: French dancers gather in a remote, empty school building to rehearse on a wintry night. The all-night celebration morphs into a hallucinatory nightmare when they learn their sangria is laced with LSD.

metas.name: Wicker
metas.description: An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

metas.name: Soulm8te
metas.description: A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.

metas.name: Evil Dead Burn
metas.description: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they transform into deadites, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life - survive even in death.

metas.name: Clayface
metas.description: Rising Hollywood star Matt Hagen descends into a horrifying revenge-filled monster when scientific ambition strips him of his identity and humanity.

metas.name: Whalefall
metas.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

metas.name: The Social Reckoning
metas.description: Follows Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, who enlisted the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

metas.name: Jane B. for Agnes V.
metas.description: "I'll look at you, but not at the camera. It could be a trap," whispers Jane Birkin shyly into Agnès Varda's ear at the start of JANE B. PAR AGNES V. The director of CLEO FROM 5 TO 7 and VAGABOND once again paints a portrait of a ...

metas.name: Pervert Park
metas.description: Pervert Park follows the everyday lives of the sex offenders in the park as they struggle to reintegrate into society.

metas.name: Taekwondo
metas.description: A man invites another guy he trains with to spend some time in his country house among other male friends.

metas.name: A Separation
metas.description: A married couple have to decide whether to improve their daughter's life by moving abroad or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent with Alzheimer's disease.

metas.name: All We Imagine as Light
metas.description: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

metas.name: The Holy Mountain
metas.description: In a corrupt, greed-fueled world, a powerful alchemist leads a messianic character and seven materialistic figures to the Holy Mountain, where they hope to achieve enlightenment.

metas.name: One Battle After Another
metas.description: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

metas.name: Streamers
metas.description: Four young soldiers waiting to be shipped to Viet Nam deal with racial tension and their own intolerance when one soldier reveals he's gay.

metas.name: Suspiria
metas.description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

metas.name: Bonjour Tristesse
metas.description: Spoiled Cecile, 17, spends her summer at the French Riviera with her rich, widower, playboy dad and Elsa. Anne, her late mom's friend, visits and brings changes to all.

metas.name: Mandy
metas.description: The enchanted lives of a couple in a secluded forest are brutally shattered by a nightmarish hippie cult and their demon-biker henchmen, propelling a man into a spiraling, surreal rampage of vengeance.

metas.name: Noroi
metas.description: A prominent paranormal journalist Kobayashi goes missing shortly after completing a documentary. What begins as an investigation into strange noises soon evolves into the chilling mystery of a demonic entity named Kagutaba.

metas.name: Leviathan
metas.description: A documentary shot in the North Atlantic and focused on the commercial fishing industry.

metas.name: Honeyland
metas.description: The last female bee-hunter in Europe must save the bees and return the natural balance in Honeyland, when a family of nomadic beekeepers invade her land and threaten her livelihood.

metas.name: Law of Desire
metas.description: A gay filmmaker becomes involved with an obsessive fan while still pining for his absent true love. Meanwhile, he shares a close but complex relationship with his trans sister, an actress.
